notes.title: Magitek VR - Version 0.11.08 - 17/04/2025
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Easter – Update Notes[/h1]

[h2]Easter Egg Hunt Begins![/h2]

The Magitek Easter Egg Hunt has started!

We’ve hidden 6 Easter eggs throughout the entire game.

Find them all to unlock a super rare skin!

Join our Discord for hints, collaborate with the community, and enjoy the hunt!

The Courtyard is now adorned with festive Easter decorations—explore and discover!

---

[h2]New Tek Weapons[/h2]

Introducing two new Tek weapons:
[list]
[*]Tek Sword
[*]Tek Shield
[/list]

These weapons are in early stages, and we welcome your feedback as we continue to refine them.

[b]Tek Sword Elemental Modes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fire: Transforms into an axe dealing heat damage upon striking with the axe head.
[*]Air: Becomes a swift katana with rapid swings and lower damage.
[*]Earth: Converts into a heavy, slow-moving hammer delivering powerful blows.
[*]Water: Morphs into a spear that inflicts bonus damage on headshots.
[list]
[*]In multiplayer, a precise headshot with the Water Tek Spear will freeze the enemy.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Tek Shield Elemental Modes[/b]

Tek Shields all have a passive ability that can be activated by holding the trigger. The shield uses mana, and once it reaches zero, you must wait for it to recharge before using it again.

[list]
[*]Fire: Produces a flamethrower that deals continuous damage in front of you.
[*]Air: Generates a jet of air that launches you in the direction the shield is facing.
[*]Earth: Becomes a heavy shield that makes you immune to pushback.
[*]Water: Expands in size with ice, creating a larger blocking surface.
[/list]

[b]Additional Update[/b]
[list]
[*]The Tek Bow is now available in multiplayer mode.
[/list]

We are actively balancing and enhancing all Tek weapons. Your feedback is invaluable—please share your thoughts!

---

[h2]New Tutorial Available[/h2]

A new tutorial has been added!

Access it in the Academy from the Main Menu.

[list]
[*]"Basics" Lesson is available now.
[*]Advanced lessons will be introduced in the coming weeks.
[/list]

---

[h2]New Skins in the Store[/h2]

Six new skins have been added to the in-game store:
[list]
[*]Flanny Hood
[*]Flanny Body
[*]Confetti Hood
[*]Confetti Body
[*]Easter Eggs Hood
[*]Easter Eggs Body
[/list]

Explore the store and customize your appearance with these new seasonal additions!

---

See you in-game!

notes.title: Magitek VR - Version 0.11.05 - 13/03/2025
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added two new levels to the multiplayer stadium; Duel and Towers
[*]Then opening the oculus overlay, voice recording is muted.
[*]Story mode notification message system has been removed in favor of simpler popup messages. 
[*]The game no longer includes meta restricted permissions. 
[*]Added a no internet message to multiplayer when the user has no network connection 
[*]Improved damage consistency, we are working on getting damage to be more consistent across all spells, in this update we applied our new system to; gust, air shuriken, ground pound and ice lance. 
[/list]

[h2]Abilities[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reworked air blast, it now requires far less charge (the same as gust), lasts much longer, but does less damage. This should give air a nice mobility boost. 
[*]Reworked water tentacle, is now cast with a single hand, with a slight charge and a pulled back fist (like earth glove). Damage is now based on how fast you * swing, with more damage being delt at the tip.
[*]Removed the fire that is generated from fire spray for fire spray to create fire in the world (we have much bigger plans coming for fire soon)
[*]Water tentacle hit force reduced by 20% on single player to account for faster casting  
[*]Water balls can be hover positioned, release a water ball from a tether as while it's stationary and the water ball will hover in that position. 
[*]Water balls now limited at 5 at a time 
[*]Wave is now limited to 4 at a time 
[*]Earth wall punching power has been reduced but its defense has been greatly increased 
[*]Earth wall destroy time increased from 10 seconds to 180 seconds 
[*]Earth wall can only be grabbed by one hand at a time  
[*]Earth boulder can only be picked up with one hand 
[*]Earth shield defense has been greatly increased 
[*]Earth boulder punch mobility reduced by 20% (punching while holding the boulder) 
[*]Water whip no longer does damage while held 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] *Fixed a memory leak on multiplayer stadium 
[*] *Fixed frozen weight increase sometimes not removing when the frozen effects is removed
[*] *Fixed some visual artefacts on the first loading Magitek icon 
[*] *Fixed water ball not correctly blocking in multiplayer 
[*] *Joining un-supported regions fixed, auto join will force the user to one of the supplied regions 
[*] *Fixed starting a server from an unsupported region, in the past 
[*] *Water whip no longer does damage while being held in the player hand 
[*] *Fixed typo in sandbox menu 
[*] *Fixed player body not hiding when selected to be hidden in the settings menu 
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer is now live!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that our Magitek multiplayer is officially live, and we can’t wait for you to jump in and start battling!

This is still an early version, so expect some bugs along the way. We're actively working on improvements, so feel free to share your feedback, ideas, and any bugs you come across!

Nothing is set in stone just yet, so this is your chance to shape the final release with us. Let us know all the cool ideas you have for abilities, balancing, or anything else you’d love to see!

We’re looking forward to battling it out with you all very soon!

[h2]New Features / Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New multiplayer mode, access it from the main menu
[*] Two multiplayer modes; Stadium and Sandbox.
[*] New multiplayer lobby scene where you can connect to multiplayer games
[*] New headshots damage multiplier, do more damage when you hit an AI or human enemy in the head.
[*] New reworked water elements, the class now specialists at long ranged attacks that do bonus damage when getting headshots
[*] New frozen system for multiplayer, frozen players will move slower and have increased weight.
[*] New skin system where you can customize your hood, body, add rings and attach items to head and back.
[*] New mirror and skin selector UI. Found in the Multiplayer lobby and the home base in story mode
[*] New arena season 3, the season 2 scoreboard can now be found in the courtyard.
[/list]
[h2]New Spells[/h2]
[list]
[*] New air Spell - Air Disk - Throw this disk like a throwing star, it expands as it travels doing high damage.
[*] New earth Spell - Ground Pound - While in the air punch towards the ground to fly towards the ground ending in an shockwave.
[*] New water Spell - Water Lash - A spell that will cast a water rope to any part of the environment, you can swing on it or pull yourself towards the target. Great for mobility.
[*] New water spell - Ice Lance - Cast by freezing a water ball, this sharp ice projectile does very high damage when hitting heads.
[*] New water spell - Wave - A large wave of water that can hit multiple enemies, can be frozen to create a frozen wall for defence.
[*] New water spell - Frost Walker - Cast and equip giving a speed boost while on land.
[/list]
[h2]Spell Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fire spray now consumes far less mana.
[*] Fire blast is now three times larger, making it much easier to hit targets.
[*] Fire arc can now be charged to a larger 3rd level.
[*] Improved hit detection on air blast.
[*] Reworked earth boulder and earth wall, casting will now tether the earth object to the player hand.
[*] Improved earth telekinesis on all earth spells.
[*] New cracked effects on earth wall when it have taken damage.
[*] Water Ball can now be cast much more quickly and will tether to the hand.
[*] Water whip can now be charged to become larger. It now has increased pushback and damage.
[*] Liquid Tentacles are now casting by bring two fists together and charging, they are fare stronger now.
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ice storm removed.
[*] New popup message to show important information.
[*] New “Show body” option to show the players body.
[*] Improved abilities UI, spell instructions are now more clear and easier to read.
[*] Popup menu is now larger and more readable.
[*] Remove element passives.
[*] Added dynamic resolution to improve performance.
[*] Audio sliders to adjust volumes.
[*] Many new sounds.
[/list]

notes.title: Story Mode Update - Chapter 2 - Earth & Much More
notes.content:
Just in time for Christmas we have a huge update for you. 

[h2]Story Update - Chapter 2 - Earth[/h2]
The next chapter of story mode has been released, exploring the underground earth caves and dungeons under Ignis Isle and continuing the story. 

[list]
[*] We have 4 new new earth levels, with 20 shards and 24 lore pages to discover 
[*] Unlock all the earth spells in story mode and use them to further explore Ignis Isle 
[*] Ignis isle has been split with the islands now further apart, this gives us a big performance boost on Quest.
[*] Fire blast can now be unlocked in chapter 1.
[*] Fire spray and fire bomb have had their unlock positions changed 
[*] Your crashed airship can now be seen on the start beach and can be entered 
[*] The crashed airship will act as your home base 
[*] A simple store has been added to the home base 
[*] Collected Lore pages can be viewed in the home base
[*] A completion screen has been added to the home base where you can see your total complement percentage of the current version of story mode 
[*] A storage locker has been added to home base to store items 
[*] The Tek bow can be purchased at the store and used in story mode
[/list]

[h2]Player[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new Tek watch has been added to both hands, this will show health, mana, coins and active status effects.
[*] Notifications now show up on the Tek watch, pressing the left Tek watch will open the notification on the pop up menu for more details. 
[*] A new grab vault has been added, grab onto a static object with two hands then pull yourself up to perfect a smooth and easy climb. 
[*] An element swapper has been added that will allow you to quickly swap between different elements.
[/list]

[h2]Ability changes [/h2]
We have a whole set of ability changes from balancing, to adding more details to spells to all new spells entirely.

[h3]Fire [/h3]
[list]
[*] Spray will now leave fire in the world you can make a fire wall 
[*] Fire in hand now grows hotter as you charge 
[*] Blast will provide a small amount of boos to the player 
[/list]
[h3]Air [/h3]
[list]
[*] New Spell - Deflect - new air spell that will defect low mass attacks like fire and air projectiles back at the caster 
[*] Air bolts now do slightly more damage 
[*] Air passive will now give more hover effect, equipping two air crystals will give double hover effect.
[*] Air passive now has more jump increase 
[/list]
[h3]Earth [/h3]
[list]
[*] New spell - Fortify - Charge with two earth hands, this spell will encase you in earth armour providing resistance to all damage types. Fortify also increases player weight.
[*] New Spell - Super Strength  - equipping an earth crystal in a hand will give increased strength. Heavier objects can be lifted easier and held items can be thrown further. 
[*] Boulder grab and punch - using strength you can now grab your summoned boulders. Punching these while holding will give a boost, this can be done three times before the boulder breaks. Use this for a bit of mobility. 
[*] Charging and then casting earth shields will produce a shield with spikes with increased damage
[*] Quake boost - Quake now much more reliably boosts the player if released under the player.
[*] Quake can now be controlled up and down sloped surfaces.
[*] Earth damages have been tweaked. 
[/list]

[h2]Arena[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new arena season has been added that includes Tek bots and more intense combat.
[*] Score modifiers have been added and include - reduced player health, increased enemy health and increased enemy damage.  These will give a score boost and can be stacked.
[*] Element combos can be used in the arena, eg. fire in one hand and earth in the other. 
[*] Element swapper can be used in the arena so you can battle with all 4 elements simultaneously. This can be selected as a modifier. 
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]Enemies [/h2]
[list]
[*] Earth Tek bots are now in the sandbox, story and arena.
[*] Lv 1 earth tek bots are equip with earth gloves and will charge the player 
[*] Lv 2 is equip with a shield and will summon boulders 
[*] Lv 3 will summon boulder and walls
[*] Lv 4 is an experimental giant enemy that can be summoned in the sandbox 
[/list]

[h2]UX / UI [/h2]
[list]
[*] Tutorial has been updated to now have a few more steps 
[*] Carl can now be seen in the tutorial and will follow you from step to step 
[*] New control screens have been added that better show which controller button needs to be pressed 
[*] The shard display in the quest log now shows collected fire and earth crystal shards. As well as having place holders for air and water shards. 
[*] Ancient Tek screens have been added to story mode.
[*] Shard unlock door have been added, these are doors that need a certain number of shards to be unlocked. 
[/list]

[h2]Other [/h2]
[list]
[*] Four Easter eggs have been hidden in the world, see if you can find them all.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Items not correct store in your backpack and are not removed when the game is reset
[*] A bug where some players could only collect 19 fire shards has now been fixed 
[*] A bug with caused the game to crash on certain earth ability collisions has been fixed
[*] Duplicate shard and lore page collection has been permanently fixed with ID checking 
[/list]

notes.title: Tek Bots added - New humanoid enemy
notes.content:
It's update time and we have a big one for you this time, Magitek VR version 0.8.0 has the following main features: 

[list]
[*] Our new enemy is the ‘Tek Bot’, a fully physical humanoid enemy. 
[*] Tek Bow is now added to the sandbox
[*] Water magic in arena
[*] Updated UI for - in game menu, main menu and the sandbox menu
[*] Recording features for PCVR
[*] Some spell changes and tweaks 
[*] Bug fixes 
[/list]

[h2]Tek Bots [/h2]
We have been working on our new class of enemy for a while now and we are super excited for you all to battle with our new enemy the Tek Bot. Our Tek Bots are fully physics run enemies, which means they react to all our physics spells and this opens up infinite ways to battle them.  Before we get into the features let's go over the new damage system that was added. This better helps define abilities and their properties. 

[h3]Damage Types[/h3]
[b]Heat[/b]-  thermal damage that will heat an object 
[b]Frost[/b]-  thermal damage that will cool an object 
[b]Kinetic[/b]- damage caused by a collision 
[b]Slash[/b]- a sharp collision, this can slice 
[b]Water[/b]- Wets things and does a little cooling 
[b]Explosive[/b]- Destruction damage
[b]Shockwave [/b]- Deals damage and pushes 

And now here is the feature list of what is included in this update 

[h2]Tek bots[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Fully physical enemies, push them over, trip them and send them flying with ragdoll goodness.
[*]  Three levels of fire tek bot, levels one, two and three 
[*] Higher level tek bots are larger and heavier and will react less to all abilities. 
[*] Low level tek bots can be picked up and thrown, heavier bots can be climbed and ridden.
[*] Tek bot limbs can be sliced off with slashing abilities or blown off with explosive abilities. 
[*] Cutting off limbs can stop abilities from being cast
[*] Beheading insta kills the enemy, this can be done with slashing and explosive abilities
[*] As enemies are physically simulated they can be knocked over, this will cancel any attack they have underway. 
[*] Aiming at an enemies legs with powerful attack can trip up the enemy.  Items like the ‘hook on a stick’ can also be used to trip enemies. 
[*] Higher level tek bots can have armour which will help protect against; limb slicing, decapitation and leg tripping. Although it is still possible to do these things. 
[*] Heating an object will cause it to slowly glow red
[*] Once a hot enough temperature is reached the enemy will turn smoking, damaging itself slowly over time with a burn effect. 
[*] Frost and Water damage will cool heated object and can remove a smoking effect. 
[*] Smoking enemies will explode when they die. 
[*] Explosive, kinetic, shockwave and water damage abilities can push an enemy back with a force. 
[*] Killing an enemy with slash damage will result in a body split KO. 
[*] Freezing an object will cause it to slowly glow blue
[*] Get a tekbot cold enough and it will freeze. Frozen enemies can be shattered with the lightest touch, killing them instantly. 
[*] Ice surfaces like those created by the Frost Spray will cause Tek Bots to slip. 
[*] Tek Bots can be wet with water abilities, wet enemies will freeze faster. 
[*] Water tentacles can be used to grab any part of a tekbot, smaller tek bots can be dragged around with this. 
[*] The water tentacle flick can be applied to tek bots causes them to go flying 
[*] Water tentacle and water whips can be used to trip tek bots if aimed at the enemies feet. 
[*] Kinetic attacks such as earth abilities are very powerful and have a good chance of knocking an enemy over. 
[/list]

[h2]Tek Bow [/h2]
[list]
[*] The tek bow can now be found in the sandbox, spawn it from the sandbox menu.
[*] Tek Weapons are a new class of weapon that are empowered by the elemental crystal in your hand. [*] Changing your hand crystal will change the empowerment of the weapon. 
[*] The Tek bow has four empowerments, one for each element 
[*] Fire will create explosive arrows
[*] Air will create fast moving gust arrows that can pass through multiple objects 
[*] Earth will create quake arrows that create small earth quakes when they hit the ground.
[*] Water will create frost arrows that will freeze enemies 
[/list]

[h2]Water magic in the arena [/h2]
[list]
[*] Water magic is now accessible in the arena
[*] Water scores will now show up on the arena leaderboard 
[/list]

[h2]UI Updates [/h2]
[list]
[*] New main menu in the tek screen style
[*] New in game menu with a more intuitive design
[*] Each ability has their damage types listed in the in game menu 
[*] A help page has been added to the in game menu to explain damage types 
[*] In game menu can be grabbed and moved around for finding a more comfortable position

notes.title: Water and Ice Magic Released!!
notes.content:
Get ready for a major update as water magic has just been released! Water magic is a combination of water and ice abilities that focus on fluid attacks for water and precise sharp motions for ice.  There are 10 new abilities to try and one passive; these can all be found in the sandbox. 

[h1]NEW ABILITIES[/h1]
The passive for water is [b]Ice Walker[/b] which lets you walk/run faster on ice.

[b]Splash[/b] - A water splash that does light damage in a moderate area of attack. 

[b]Water whip[/b] - Summon a water whip that can be shot forward and returned to your hand. Very effectively at hitting enemies at long range. 

[b]Water tentacle[/b] - Summon a water tentacle, a powerful ability that can swipe, grab and throw enemies. Any part of the environment can be gripped with the tip of the tentacle, you can then swing or pull yourself up making it a great ability for exploring.

[b]Water ball[/b] - A ball of water that can be manipulated and combined with other water sources to grow larger, doing moderate damage this ball can also be used defensively. Targeting the water ball will turn it into a powerful ice attack. 

[b]Ice shard[/b] - A sharp ice shard that can penetrate enemies and the environment.  Ice shards can be collected once cast and used to scale walls to stab enemies with. 

[b]Ice shuriken [/b] -  Fast summon an ice shuriken.  Deals high frost damage but does require some skill to be accurate.

[b]Frost[/b] - A frost spray that can freeze enemies and the environment. Freezing the ground will create a slippery surface that will give you a speed boost thanks to your passive. 

[b]Ice storm[/b] - A blast of ice shards that is super effective at close range. 

[b]Ice bomb[/b] - A very cold frost attack that will freeze everything around it. 

[b]Snap freeze[/b] - Target a wet enemy to freeze it instantly, you need to be close to the enemy to do this. 


[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Frost damage is added to the damage system 
[*]Frost damage will appear blue on damage numbers
[*]Water abilities now put out fire abilities
[*]Water abilities can slow down incoming earth abilities 
[*]All water spells can wet enemies 
[*]Enemies can now be frozen with frost abilities and defrosted with heat abilities 
[*]Frozen enemies can be shattered with a physical attack
[*]Enemies can be wet, wet enemies will be slower and can be frozen easier
[*]Players now have more control when walking on ice
[*]A crashed airship has been added to the story mode map (more on this later)
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Decals now work correctly
[*]Passthrough attacks like gust now correctly pass through objects 
[/list]


We still have much more we want to add to this magic class, next we will be looking at how water magic will interact in the open world. Some of the things we are experimenting with are pulling water from the world to make waves and large pillars of water. 

As always we are always open to feedback so please let us know any ideas or comments you have.

notes.title: Earth Magic Update | 0.6.0.9
notes.content:
In this update we did a major rework on earth magic. We want earth users to feel heavy and powerful with slower moving, but hard hitting attacks. 

[h2]Earth Magic[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved sound effects on all earth spells
[*] Particle improvements for most earth spells 
[*] A new smooth collision system was added for all heavy hitting earth attacks. Enemies now react with more realistic forces. 
[*] Earth charge now requires the hand to be facing the ground to charge earth.
[*] There are 2 distinct earth charge states, lv1 and lv2 . These are identified by particle changes, audio cues and haptics. 
[*] New earth charge particles have been added to the ground that show when charge is active. 
[*] Earth gauntlets have been reworked, by releasing trigger but still holding grip the gauntlet will shoot forwards. Pressing the trigger again will have the gauntlet return to the hand.
[*] Earth gauntlets now have new particles to support this new mechanic. 
[*] Earth boulder has been updated to now have three distinct sizes of boulder. Small, medium and large. Small boulders require no charge and can be fired quickly, medium boulders require level 1 charge and are heavier but do much more damage. Lv2 boulders are very heavy and tough, they will kill most enemies they hit but are hard to control. 
[*] Earth wall has had some reworks, the gesture has been changed from an uppercut to palm facing down, then pulling upwards motion. See the in game menu for a video on how to cast this. 
[*] Earth walls are now physical objects and can be pushed over and manipulated. 
[*] Earth walls can be gripped and punched to travel faster across flat ground. 
[*] Earth gauntlet and shield now have more health 
[*] Earth gauntlet and shield now no longer react to power punch while in the player hand. This fixes a lot of bugs that sent the player flying. 
[*] Quake now no longer pushes objects while travelling along the ground, this allows it to better get under objects.  
[*] Quake spikes now have improved hit detection and now deal damage more consistently. 
[*] All earth spells have had their damages adjusted
[*] Reduced range of power punch 
[*] Rock climb now has audio
[/list] 

[h2]Fire Magic [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fire spark seeking now improved 
[/list]

[h2]General [/h2]
[list]
[*] Second spawn table removed from sandbox to improve optimization 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ice shard now casts correctly 
[/list]

notes.title: Air Update | 0.6.0.8
notes.content:
In this big update we did a major rework on air magic. We want air users to feel light, agile and fast attacking and we hope these changes start to make that a reality.  

[h2]Air Magic [/h2]
[list]
[*] New particles for every air spell and impact effect  
[*] New air charge effect, haptics and audio 
[*] New audio for every air spell 
[*] New haptics for casting air bolt and air blade 
[*] New Air Passive - each crystal attached gives a slight hover when falling, equipping 2 crystals gives no fall damage.  
[*] Charging air is now done in a more fluid twirling motion (see in game tutorial for exact details) 
[*] Air bolt is now a primary air attack and can be cast with a jab motion 
[*] Air blade now casts better while moving and can't travel through large objects. 
[*] Gust now requires charge to cast, charging it will make it larger 
[*] Air blast now is cast by charging and then doing a punch and hold, it is much more powerful now being able to push over heavy objects. It also deals damage. 
[*] Air punch now applies force on objects more reliably.  
[*] Air bolt attacks now leave decals on impact 
[*] New instruction videos for air spells 
[/list]

[h2]Earth Magic [/h2]
[list]
[*] Power Punch now has new hit particles 
[*] New summon effect for Rock Gauntlets and Rock Shield
[*] New sound effects for certain earth spells

[/list]

[h2]Fire Magic[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updates to our gesture detection system that should help produce more reliable gestures.
[*] Casting while moving backwards now works 
[*] Seeking property for spells added to UI 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes [/h2]
[list]
[*] Air blade now applies less force when it destroys an object 
[*] Smoke now always travels upwards on ignited objects
[*] Reduced HDR on glove crystals that was too high when post processing is enabled. 
[*] Pots now spawn correctly in sandbox 
[*] Seeking on training bag 
[*] Mortar Spiders fire arcs now correctly seek player and have upgraded particles
[*] Story mode UI now shows only spells that can be unlocked in story

[/list]

As always we are always open to feedback so please let us know any ideas or comments you have.
